description: Scans slots one to twelve and calls an unnamed routine for each slot whose value equals the stored key.

description: Reads a byte count from the current record, then loads that many words through an unnamed routine into the global table. A second loop then loads a further list in the same way.

name: load_record_tag_two

name: load_record_tag_six

name: load_record_tag_five
description: Loads and caches a record of tag type five when it is not already present, reading entries through unnamed routines until the lookup returns zero.
